name: gradient-new-retrowave
title: New Retrowave
description: A fixed three-stop gradient swatch: peach at the top, a mauve-pink band in the middle, and periwinkle blue along the bottom, delivered as a wide rounded rectangle.
use: A warm-to-cool wash should sit behind content and set a retro, nightlife mood.
avoid: The three colours are fixed in the source, so restyling needs a code edit; no motion at all.
a11y: Purely decorative fill with no controls, so keyboard, focus and labelling do not apply. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle on a black stage, filled with a smooth vertical blend. A pale peach sits at the top, passes through lavender-pink about halfway, and ends in a saturated periwinkle blue at the bottom edge.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds. Every frame shows the identical gradient.
customise: className and style let you resize it and replace the background; the peach, mauve and periwinkle stops live in the file.
weight: light: One div with a single CSS gradient, no script, timers or animation.
